subject: Exposing Log Prob and Gradients in PyStan

messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Exposing Log Prob and Gradients in PyStan
parts:
Allen,

Is it in the plans/how easy would it be to expose the model in PyStan? In particular having a model object with log prob and gradient methods as in RStan? Would you need any help?

-Mike

messages.author: 17d9c7a6e1a581b8
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Exposing Log Prob and Gradients in PyStan
parts:
Hi Mike,

Log probability is already exposed on fit objects. I believe all you need to do
is ``fit = stan(..., iter=1)`` and then ``fit.log_prob(x)`` should work.

There's an odd Cython bug that's holding up implementation of the
grad_log_prob. Thanks for reminding me. I've opened an issue on this:

https://github.com/stan-dev/pystan/issues/40

Best,

-a
